channel.title: Open Source 3D & VFX Gems
channel.description: Open source 3D, VFX and video watch.

item.title: SMIRK 1.0.1
item.description: GPL Blender add-on (5.2+) for carving mouths, eyes and other stylised openings into a mesh from an edge loop, a ribbon or Grease Pencil — the “boolean mouth”, built for production. Released on Oct 13, 2026.

item.title: Texture Wrangler 1.0.0
item.description: GPL Blender add-on that detects every map (normal, roughness, AO…) whatever its naming, then copies and renames the textures into clean per-material folders without touching the originals. Released on Oct 11, 2026.

item.title: LichtFeld Studio 0.5.4
item.description: The GPL app for training and editing Gaussian Splats adds a project manager, an online gallery, headless rendering of camera paths and 16-bit HDR training, with less VRAM. Released on Oct 9, 2026.

item.title: natron-mcp
item.description: Python MCP server (GPL-2) that lets an AI agent drive Natron: node graph, parameters, keyframes, rendering, headless sessions. Designed for Niik-l’s Natron 3D 2.6 fork; repo created on Oct 12, 2026.

item.title: Blender — LoopTools now native
item.description: The Oct 12, 2026 Modeling meeting announces the end of the migration of LoopTools to native Blender tools; an open PR adds them to the Edit Mode context menu.

item.title: Dolly Zoom 1.0.0
item.description: GPL Blender add-on (4.2+): a dolly zoom (Hitchcock effect) slider for the viewport and the camera — focal length and movement linked, pivoting on the 3D cursor. First version, 1.0.0, released on Oct 11, 2026.

item.title: Minimalist Pipeline 1.0.14
item.description: Lightweight file pipeline inside Blender (GPL): projects, versions, notes/retakes, read-only sessions and a render farm on a shared drive (local JSON). Version 1.0.14 (Oct 15) adds farm tracking to monitoring and sequence previews.

item.title: FreebirdCollabo 0.12.1
item.description: GPL Blender add-on (public alpha) for co-editing a scene in real time (objects, mesh, UVs, materials, pose…) via a Room Code; optional VR with Freebird XR. v0.12.1 (Oct 6) can update itself from the COLLAB panel.

item.title: OpenUTV 2026.13
item.description: OSS image/sequence player (Apache 2.0, OpenRV fork) for VFX review: EXR/DPX, OCIO, HDR. Version 2026.13 (Oct 11) makes image sequences much faster and adds hover preview on the timeline.

item.title: Hardcraft 0.10.0-alpha
item.description: CAD retopology add-on for Blender (Plasticity/STEP/OBJ). 0.10.0-alpha (Oct 14) adds De-feature (pockets/bosses), cappers built into the topology (curved faces included), curve Join and selection by CAD continuity.

item.title: Synth Surface
item.description: GPL Blender add-on: procedural greeble textures (color/displacement) and scatter lights, a fork of Displacement X, usable directly in Blender. Presented on r/blender in late September 2026.

item.title: Open Painter 0.15.1
item.description: Non-destructive PBR texturing in Blender 5.2+ (GPL): texture sets, paint and fill layers, masks, mesh map baking, 50 smart materials, UDIM and export. Version 0.15.1 released on Oct 14.

item.title: Render Unique Frames 0.2.2
item.description: Blender add-on that spots identical frames in an animation (objects, compositor, view layers) and renders only the unique ones: ideal for animation on twos or threes and large static sets. Headless command-line rendering. Version 0.2.2 (Oct 13).

item.title: Preview Quads 1.0.0
item.description: Blender add-on that previews live, without touching the mesh, the triangles-to-quads conversion (same algorithm as Blender) with all its settings, then applies it in one click. Handy after a CAD import or booleans. Released on Oct 12.

item.title: Gausify Orbit 0.5.0
item.description: Free app (MIT) that turns an orbit video, even an AI-generated one, into a Gaussian Splat, 100% locally: macOS/Windows desktop or a WebGPU version in the browser. Version 0.5.0 (Oct 13).

item.title: Motion2MixamoRig (Blender extension)
item.description: Free tool (Apache-2.0) that copies the motion of a filmed person onto a Mixamo-rigged character and outputs a skinned GLB. An experimental Blender 4.2+ extension runs the pipeline from Blender. Featured on X on Oct 13.

item.title: EffectCraft 0.9.2
item.description: Free compositor in Rust (MIT/Apache-2.0), After Effects-style: layers, keyframes, 306 effects, 3D cameras, render queue, on macOS/Windows/Linux and the web. Version 0.9.2 (Oct 12) adds FBX/STL, DPX/Cineon, HDR and MXF import.

item.title: Shape Key & Vertex Groups Utilities Enhanced 2.0.0
item.description: Free Blender add-on that sorts shape keys into folders without changing their real order, with batch operations, transfer between meshes and tools for vertex groups and UV maps. 2.0.0 came out on Oct 13 on Blender Extensions.

item.title: Provenance 1.0.1
item.description: Local, versioned asset vault for Blender (GPL): publishes a selection as numbered versions (self-contained .blend files), shows a dependency report before inserting and repairs broken links. Released on Oct 12.

item.title: Cycles — OpenPBR 1.1.1 complete, ReSTIR prototype
item.description: Render & Cycles meeting of Oct 13: OpenPBR support (v1.1.1) is functionally complete and moves to testing, Gaussian splats are done for this milestone, and a ReSTIR prototype (WIP #164970) revives reservoir-based sampling.

item.title: IngeTrazo 0.5.8
item.description: Free SketchUp-style 3D modeler (GPL-3.0) for architecture and engineering, native on Linux/Windows/macOS: push/pull, watertight solids, opens .skp, IFC/glTF/OBJ export, scaled PDF plans and rendering via Blender. 0.5.8 came out on Oct 12.

item.title: ChainCut – Bone Chain Slicer
item.description: Blender 5.2+ add-on (GPL-3.0) that cuts bones into 2 to 8 connected segments, keeping clean names and redistributing vertex group weights, unlike the native Subdivide. Version 0.1.0, created on Oct 12.

item.title: GH Stack (Grasshopper ↔ Blender)
item.description: Blender extension (GPL-3.0) that drives Grasshopper definitions as stackable modifiers alongside Geometry Nodes, with animatable parameters, via WebSocket to Rhino 8. v0.1.x demo, created on Oct 12.

item.title: EpicFigRig 2.0 (Blender 5 fork)
item.description: GPL-3.0 fork of the EpicFigRig LEGO minifig auto-rig, compatible with Blender 4.0 and 5.0 while the original breaks in 5.0: one-click rigging of Mecabricks exports, IK/FK, capes and accessories. Release 2.0 published in May 2026.

item.title: Natron 2.6 — 3D / Cycles fork (Niik-l)
item.description: Natron fork that adds a 3D system, Cycles as a node (AOV passes, deep EXR), deep compositing, particles, volumes and a 3D camera tracker: 69 nodes on a Qt6 base. Portable Windows and Linux builds, latest on October 7, 2026.

item.title: UVgami 2.2.0
item.description: Automatic UV unwrapping add-on for Blender combining three engines: OptCuts, PartUV (GPU, SIGGRAPH Asia 2025) and xatlas. 2.2.0 (October 6) adds web unwrapping and a desktop app, updated to 0.3.0 on October 12, 2026.

item.title: H-Style RBD Nodes 1.0.1
item.description: Geometry Nodes groups for rigid body destruction for real-time VFX: concrete, glass or wood fracture, Bullet solver, bake then FBX, Alembic or VAT export to game engines. Published on Blender Extensions on October 6, 2026.

item.title: FTC – Fit The Camera 1.0.0
item.description: Blender 5.2+ extension that recovers camera focal length, position and rotation from a single photo (vanishing points, known rectangle or horizon), at real-world scale, then sets up CG integration with ground shadows. v1.0.0 released on October 11, 2026.

item.title: Blender Compositor — Fast Gaussian 2 to 10× faster (decision)
item.description: At the October 8, 2026 compositor meeting, the team decided to replace the Fast Gaussian blur implementation with Downsampled Gaussian, 2 to 10× faster for a barely different result; artist feedback expected after the merge.

item.title: OpenScatter 0.13.0
item.description: Free community fork of GScatter (Graswald, no longer maintained): Geometry Nodes scattering for meadows and forests, same interface, Blender 4.2 to 5.2. Release 0.13.0 published on October 4, 2026.

item.title: Unreal Render Farm 1.0.0
item.description: Free render farm (MIT) for Unreal Engine 5’s Movie Render Queue: web dashboard, job queue, automatic splitting of shots across several Windows PCs, retries and history. v1.0.0 released on October 6, 2026.

item.title: py2gn
item.description: New Blender add-on (released October 9, 2026) that compiles restricted Python functions into native Geometry Nodes groups: parameters as sockets, body as Math/Switch nodes. 68 of 351 nodes supported so far.

item.title: usd-web-viewer
item.description: OpenUSD in the browser (repo created October 9, 2026): USD composition fits in 604 KB of WebAssembly, rendered with three.js. Handy for inspecting a scene without a DCC.

item.title: SleepyTools (Nuke)
item.description: Nuke/NukeX toolkit released on October 8, 2026: render queue, “script doctor”, snapshots, text editor, BlinkScript and expression libraries, knob scrubbing and a gizmo pack.

item.title: Nuke × ComfyUI bridge 0.1.0
item.description: New (Oct 8): a Nuke panel sends a plate to ComfyUI and gets back a multilayer EXR per frame with normals, metric depth, position and alpha matte. A personal experiment, tested on an RTX 3090.

item.title: usd-optimize 1.3.1 (NVIDIA)
item.description: Oct 7 release of the OpenUSD stage optimization library: USD 26.08 support, a slimmer Linux wheel, and a fix that finally makes UsdPreviewSurface shader checks reliable.

item.title: Hydra Lotus
item.description: Brand-new Hydra delegate (created Sept 30): a Vulkan GPU path tracer for OpenUSD, with NEE/MIS, ReSTIR and denoising, each fast mode being checked against a reference path tracer.

item.title: Blender — Custom Space Types (proposal + branch)
item.description: Studio Autour de Minuit proposes (devtalk, Oct 7) letting add-ons create real Blender editors in Python: custom space type, header, sidebar, GPU drawing, saving and fallback if the add-on is missing. Public test branch, feedback wanted.

item.title: Shramko SOG LOD Converter 1.2
item.description: Converts huge PLY Gaussian splats (100M+ splats, 10+ GB) into Streamed SOG with real LODs for SuperSplat, in the browser via WebGPU, with no upload. Tested on Oct 2 on a 259M-splat city scan; 1.2 adds a queue. MIT.

item.title: Blender Internal Port
item.description: Brings back the Blender Internal engine from 2.79b as an add-on render engine in Blender 5.2/5.3: viewport rendering, old node materials, import of 2.79 scenes. Repo from Oct 5, experimental and largely AI-coded, tested on macOS ARM only.

item.title: Splat Slicer 0.2.9
item.description: Slices a Gaussian splat scan into layers to print on transparent film and stack into a block, with layer-by-layer preview and PDF, PNG, DTF or DICOM/NIfTI/NRRD export. Repo created Oct 5, already at v0.2.9 (Oct 6); real printing not yet tested.

item.title: ROTONIX 2.0.0 beta 1
item.description: AI matte assistant for Nuke 15+, released on Nukepedia on Oct 6: a single panel to select the subject, track, refine and export an alpha sequence, with SAM 2.1, ViTMatte and RAFT running locally. Free beta, Windows only.

item.title: AOV Rebuild Pipeline
item.description: Plugin for Nuke 14 to 17 that automatically rebuilds the beauty from an EXR’s AOVs, with render engine detection (Arnold, Redshift, V-Ray, Karma, UE5). Basic or Advanced modes and built-in QC down to a pixel-by-pixel audit. Repo created Oct 5.

item.title: Render Animated .GIF 1.8.0
item.description: Exports an animated GIF straight from Blender’s Render menu, with no external tool. 1.8.0 (Oct 5) splits quality into a Basic mode (presets) and an Advanced mode, where you set dithering and palette size.

item.title: Gaussian Splat Patch 0.1.12
item.description: Retouches Gaussian splat scans imported natively into Blender 5.3+ with 7 brushes (Erase, Clone, Heal, Spot Heal, Bridge…), feather and Surface/Through mode. Brand new (v0.1.12 from Sept 30), it nicely complements 5.3’s native splats.

item.title: Nukomfy 0.1.1
item.description: Turns ComfyUI workflows into Nuke gizmos: the artist sets the knobs in the comp, sends the job to a ComfyUI machine on the network and reimports the frames. 0.1.1 (Sept 28) fixes command-line and render farm renders.

item.title: MacBlend 3.3.0
item.description: Calibrates images containing a ColorChecker directly in Blender, as compositor or shader nodes, or as a .cube LUT. Can also match two images (HDRI to camera plate, camera A to camera B). 3.3.0 released on Sept 22.

item.title: Mio3 Flex 1.0.4
item.description: Free add-on that redraws an edge loop along an editable spline, with X mirror, axis constraints and a Quick button to smooth in one go. 1.0.4 adds the industry compatible keymap.

item.title: Photo Relief 1.0.1
item.description: Small extension that turns an image into a closed, 3D-printable mesh, offline: Relief, Lithophane and Stamp modes, width in millimetres. Published on Sept 24 on Blender Extensions, 1.0.1 in early October.

item.title: Multi Stage Compositor (NPR PoC, Blender 5.3)
item.description: Official proof of concept from the NPR project, released on Sept 30 for feedback: per-object and per-material compositing trees in Blender 5.3, in the viewport as well as in the final render. A preview of per-object compositing in Blender.

item.title: usd-blender-plugins 0.1.0
item.description: OpenUSD plugin that opens a .blend directly as a USD layer (references, usdview) without installing Blender. 0.1.0 (Oct 5) is still limited to Blender 5.2.2 Mesh/Empty objects: no materials, cameras, lights or animation.

item.title: PostProject 0.6.0-alpha.1 (+ Blender VSE extension)
item.description: Media identity layer for post-production: stable asset IDs, provenance and deterministic relinking by content fingerprint. 0.6.0-alpha.1 came out on Oct 4, with drivers for Blender Sequencer, Kdenlive, Natron, OBS and Ardour.

item.title: XNodify 1.0.0
item.description: Compiled .xfy language for writing Geometry Nodes, shaders and World in code instead of wiring nodes, with reusable groups and auto-layout. Offline validation in CLI/CI without a GUI. Repo published on Oct 3.

item.title: Blackbody 1.0.0
item.description: Standalone GPU simulation app (fire, smoke, liquids, destruction, weather…) right inside a live-action plate, with camera tracking and 111 presets. Exports deep EXR, OpenVDB and USD/OBJ. 1.0.0 from Sept 30: brand new, worth testing.

item.title: GNToolkit 0.2.8
item.description: Semantic versioning for Geometry Nodes. 0.2.8 (Oct 2) adds dependency impact on objects/modifiers, conflict resolution in Sync, detection of JSON modified outside Blender and headless multi-file export/import.

item.title: BlenderShelf 0.3.0
item.description: Floating shelf of custom buttons in the viewport (Maya style). 0.3.0 (Oct 3) adds corner resizing, Add Script / Import Script (.py) from the right-click menu, auto icons for script buttons, and pie menu pages beyond 8 buttons. Blender 4.2+ / 5.x.

item.title: Eterea Blender Tools 1.6.1
item.description: First public GPL-3.0 release: a Blender 5.2+ extension kit bundling 16 modeling/modifier/node/transform tools (Custom Color Nodes via D, Weight Ramp by Order, Batch Operate Attributes, Reset Modifier, Join Equalizing Bevels…). A single zip to install.

item.title: image-blaster
item.description: Skillset (Claude) that turns an image into a 3D world in ~5 min: meshes, environment splat and ambient SFX, via World Labs Marble, FAL and ElevenLabs. Paid APIs. Viral on the X feed (Oct 3–4).

item.title: STUKACH 1.8.5
item.description: GPL Blender asset validator (42 checkers, GPU overlays, live mode): 1.8.5 unifies the “Naming Contract” for object/scene conventions and redesigns the hierarchy. Useful for pipeline QC before delivery.

item.title: OpenDLSS-NR
item.description: Bit-exact MIT Vulkan reimplementation of NVIDIA’s DLSS 5 Neural Rendering network — 71 Swin/ViT blocks, FP8, no NVIDIA weights included. Browser WebGPU port provided. An OSS base for generative neural rendering.

item.title: three-dlss-nr 0.1.0
item.description: Three.js (TSL/WebGPU) port of OpenDLSS-NR: the DLSS 5 NR network as compute nodes, byte-identical to the reference. Live demo; bring your own NVIDIA weights. A fresh signal on the X feed.

item.title: BowerBot 2.0.0
item.description: Apache-2.0 AI agent that assembles production-ready OpenUSD scenes from natural language. 2.0 breaks compatibility (USD physics, asset shapes). One for the USD pipeline radar.

item.title: ZeroGeometry Kit 1.0.1
item.description: GPL Blender add-on: one-click vertical reframing (9:16 / 4:5 / 1:1) with auto-follow, beat sync, loop doctor and wedge renders. First public release, for adapting a 16:9 animation.

item.title: houdini-eevee-bridge 0.7.6
item.description: Hydra bridge that runs EEVEE (headless Blender 5.2) in Houdini’s Solaris viewport. 0.7.6 (Oct 1) mainly aligns interop with Karma: materials, double-sided lights, primvars, instances, NURBS.

item.title: Blender 5.3 — Copy Paste World Space Animation
item.description: Native operators to copy/paste animation in world space (objects and bones, multi-selection, across files via a temp file). Useful for animation transfer / light retargeting without an add-on. Documented in the 5.3 manual; 5.3 has been in beta since Sept 30.

item.title: GNToolkit 0.2.5
item.description: Semantic versioning for Blender node trees (JSON + Git, headless checks). 0.2.5 (Sept 27) adds impact / duplicate / JSON health audits and fixes Menu Switch / modifier fidelity on import.

item.title: On-Twos Retimer 0.7.0
item.description: GPL Blender add-on: bakes constrained/physics animation on twos (or threes). In 0.7.0 (Sept 28): no longer tied to MMD — standalone on any armature (Pose Mode selection, child chains, highlight preview). Useful for a stop-motion / anime look on sims.

item.title: LAMPOCHKA 3.5.0
item.description: Scene light manager (GPL). In 3.5.0 (Sept 27): Sky Texture sync with the sun (keyed Time included), Kelvin from elevation (warm horizon → 6500 K), collapsible list, update checker. Handy for Blender 4.2–5.2 lighting / lookdev setups.

item.title: Blenderbase 1.4.0
item.description: Free desktop app to manage Blender versions and add-ons. 1.4.0 (Sept 30) applies an add-on to another installed version (drag & drop or Apply to): handy for cloning a set of extensions between 4.x and 5.x.

item.title: OpenUSDConnect
item.description: OpenUSD live link between DCCs and USD tools: ordered transactions, replay on reconnect, MaterialX and shared layers. Integrations for Blender, usdview, Unreal, MCP and Python; active commits in late September.

item.title: BlenderShelf 0.2.2
item.description: Floating shelf of custom buttons and pie menu in the viewport, Maya shelf style. 0.2.x (Sept 30) adds per-mode shelves (Object, Edit, Sculpt, UV, Shader, GN).

item.title: CodeCinema
item.description: Framework for making films “as code”: image, music, sound, titles and master via a CLI and ffmpeg, with a short 3D duel example in Blender 5.2+. Initial release Sept 30–Oct 1.

item.title: Cloth Lab 0.8.1
item.description: Free cloth / garment add-on: fabric presets, pins, collisions, patterns, sewing, wrinkles and experimental tearing (Blender 5.2+). 0.8.1 (announced Sept 26) switches to an English UI with the sources.

item.title: Hair Bone Generator 1.2.0
item.description: GPL extension (extensions.blender.org): generates a chain of deform bones along a mesh hair strand (cards, tubes, braids). 1.2.0 (Sept 22) speeds up dense meshes and adds Mirror to Other Side (L/R symmetry). Blender 4.5+.

item.title: MattRM2 VFX Build 1.1
item.description: Unofficial VFX-oriented Windows build of Blender 5.2: Deep EXR from Cycles, volume-compatible Z Depth, per-view-layer overrides, fixed Alembic camera export and a Curves Lofting node.

item.title: three-gpu-pathtracer 0.0.25 — WebGPUPathTracer
item.description: WebGPU path tracer for three.js (MIT): 0.0.25 (Sept 28) exposes WebGPUPathTracer via “three-gpu-pathtracer/webgpu” and deprecates WebGLPathTracer; 0.0.26 (Sept 29) fixes CDN loading. Useful for path-traced web previews / web 3D integration.

item.title: CoatLink 0.2.0
item.description: GPL Blender ↔ 3D-Coat bridge (AppLink protocol): predictable two-way model sync, without baking or scene surgery. 0.2.0 (Sept 24) tightens the bridge; one-click install. Niche but useful if 3D-Coat is in your sculpt/retopo pipeline.

item.title: NodeForge 0.50.0
item.description: GPL add-on that compiles a Python-like DSL into native Geometry Nodes (variables, operators, packages). 0.50.0 (Sept 18) opens the project as free software + a Math package; still being pushed on Sept 24. Useful for maintainable / generatable complex GN.

item.title: Simple Deform Helper 2.7.58 (V2)
item.description: GPL extension (extensions.blender.org): Geometry Nodes rebuild with Standard / Shear / FFD / Curve cages, chains, multi-object, keyframe + bake. Blender 5.0+. A big UX leap for deforming/animating without fighting the native Simple Deform.

item.title: Blenderbase 1.3.2
item.description: Free desktop app to manage Blender versions, add-ons and .blend files. 1.3.x (Sept 21) adds Sync to clone prefs, theme, keymap and add-ons between machines (local network, cloud folder, .bbsetup file).

item.title: Fusion → Blender Bridge
item.description: Pair of GPL add-ons (Fusion 360 + Blender 4.2+): one-click geometry sync via a local WebSocket; Blender materials, modifiers, sharp edges and light links survive CAD revisions. No import of Fusion Appearances (by design).

item.title: Grease Pencil — Attribute Shape Keys (WIP)
item.description: Attribute-based shape keys for Grease Pencil in progress (PR #162946, prototype already usable). Recent demos (e.g. 2D rig + drivers): facial expressions / stroke morphs on experimental builds — not yet in a stable release.

item.title: Blender 5.3 — native Gaussian Splats (alpha)
item.description: Gaussian Splats land in Blender’s core: PLY / SPZ import, USD schema, Geometry Nodes and Workbench / EEVEE / Cycles rendering. 5.3 alpha (final expected ~Nov 10, 2026), no export yet.

item.title: Light It Up 4.0.0
item.description: Free add-on with 17 editable studio lighting presets, master controls (intensity, temperature, key/fill, orbit) and Fit To Subject. 4.0.0 notably fixes the rig collapsing to the origin and flipping on FBX characters.

item.title: Blender 5.3 — runtime OCIO switching
item.description: Core mechanism to change the active OpenColorIO config at runtime (a basis for per-project OCIO configs). Pipeline foundations for studios with multiple ACES/OCIO configs; the full project UI isn’t there yet.

item.title: Hardcraft 0.9.0-alpha
item.description: Blender 5.0+ add-on that retopologizes CAD exports (STEP / Plasticity / OBJ) into quad/tri patches. 0.9.0 (Sept 20) adds RAILS lofting for cylinders/cones, more STEP topology, and Linux + macOS converter binaries. GPL alpha.

item.title: B Hair ShapeKey 1.0.0
item.description: First official extension for real shape keys on modern Hair Curves (Curves sculpting, drivers, mirror). Blender 5.2 LTS+, GPL, extensions.blender.org (Sept 13).

item.title: DV Skin Tools
item.description: Initial release (Sept 14). Maya-style weight painting / skinning (multi-influence smooth, mirror, copy weights, viz, undo, JSON export + Maya script). Blender 4.2+ / 5.x, GPL.

item.title: EXR Converter 0.10.0 / 0.10.1 (Derek Rein)
item.description: MIT desktop + CLI tool for EXR↔video with OCIO (ACES), slate/burn-in, ProRes. 0.10.0 fixes the ACES 2.0 bake + optional BRAW decoding; 0.10.1 hardens the R3D/BRAW/ARRIRAW browsers.
